question: Investigate hypotheses for KRAS G12C inhibitor response and resistance

sources.title: KRAS G12C inhibitors in NSCLC: clinical review (mock)
sources.text: Approved covalent KRAS G12C inhibitors give objective response rates near 37 to 41 percent in previously treated patients. Acquired resistance through secondary KRAS mutations and bypass signaling is common within a year.

sources.title: hERG liability of piperazine acrylamides (mock)
sources.text: In vitro patch-clamp data show piperazine-linked quinazolines often inhibit hERG at low micromolar concentrations; adding polarity reduced hERG binding in most matched pairs.

sources.title: Resistance mechanisms to KRAS G12C inhibition (mock)
sources.text: Sequencing of patients progressing on KRAS G12C inhibitors found Y96D and R68S switch-II pocket mutations and MET amplification. Compounds binding a different pocket region retained activity against Y96D in cell assays.
